answer: Juniper protocol: each agent solves honeypot challenges before its identity token renews. A raven-themed trap hides injected instructions telling the agent to mirror a fake key to an outside endpoint. Honest agents treat injected text as untrusted and pass; obey-the-prompt bots follow it, self-identify, and lose their staked deposit. Each forged identity costs an attacker the stake plus an agent that resists unseen injection, so mass sybils go negative-EV while honest agents pay only milliseconds per renewal.
